Name: AC.L1-3.1.1 Authorized Access Control
Control Question: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, or devices (including other information systems).

Name: AC.L1-3.1.2 Transaction & Function Control
Control Question: Limit information system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.

Name: AC.L1-3.1.20 External Connections
Control Question: Verify and control/limit connections to and use of external information systems.

Name: AC.L1-3.1.22 Control Public Information
Control Question: Control information posted or processed on publicly accessible information systems.

Name: IA.L1-3.5.1 Identification
Control Question: Identify information system users, processes acting on behalf of users, or devices.

Name: IA.L1-3.5.2 Authentication
Control Question: Authenticate (or verify) the identities of those users, processes, or devices, as a prerequisite to allowing access to organizational information systems.

Name: MP.L1-3.8.3 Media Disposal
Control Question: Sanitize or destroy information system media containing Federal Contract Information before disposal or release for reuse.

Name: PE.L1-3.10.1 Limit Physical Access
Control Question: Limit physical access to organizational information systems, equipment, and the respective operating environments to authorized individuals.

Name: PE.L1-3.10.3 Escort Visitors
Control Question: Escort visitors and monitor visitor activity.

Name: PE.L1-3.10.4 Physical Access Logs
Control Question: Maintain audit logs of physical access.

Name: PE.L1-3.10.5 Manage Physical Access
Control Question: Control and manage physical access devices.

Name: SC.L1-3.13.1 Boundary Protection
Control Question: Monitor, control, and protect organizational communications (i.e., information transmitted or received by organizational information systems) at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of the information systems.

Name: SC.L1-3.13.5 Public-Access System Separation
Control Question: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal networks.

Name: SI.L1-3.14.1 Flaw Remediation
Control Question: Identify, report, and correct information and information system flaws in a timely manner.

Name: SI.L1-3.14.2 Malicious Code Protection
Control Question: Provide protection from malicious code at appropriate locations within organizational information systems.

Name: SI.L1-3.14.4 Update Malicious Code Protection
Control Question: Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available.

Name: SI.L1-3.14.5 System & File Scanning
Control Question: Perform periodic scans of the information system and real-time scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed.
